What changed in AIR 100 Sattwik’s preparation that helped him improve his Mains performance?

Sattwik Sir shares how consistent answer writing made a difference in his final attempt. During the two months between Prelims and Mains, he completed six to seven notebooks, wrote 2–3 answers daily and attempted a full-length test every 4–5 days.
